units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Obadiah 1:21">Targ. Ob. I, 21</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 9:9">Targ. Jud. IX, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:11">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דארעא כעין מ׳ דרקיעא</he> royal majesty on earth is similar to that of heaven.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:12">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>חשיבי דמ׳</he> the notables of the (Roman) empire.

<cite ref="Tamid 32a:51">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>יסני מלכו וכ׳</he> let him shun government and governor; <he>ירחם מ׳ וכ׳</he> let him be a friend of government and ruler and (use his influence to) do good to mankind.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>מַלְכוּתַיְיהוּ אחורי וכ׳</he> their rulership dwells behind their ears, i.e. they may rise to power at some future time.
Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ משכי במַלְכוּתַיְיהוּ עד וכ׳ (or מַלְכְוָ׳, Pl.) they will continue in power until the Messiah comes; a. fr.—Pl. מַלְכְוָן, מַלְכְוָתָא, מַלְכְוָו׳.
